title: Unphilosophic
summary: UNPHILOSOPH'IC, UNPHILOSOPH'ICAL, adjective Not according to the rules or principles of sound philosophy; contrary to philosophy or right reason.

inlines.v: UNPHILOSOPH'IC, UNPHILOSOPH'ICAL, adjective Not according to the rules or principles of sound philosophy; contrary to philosophy or right reason.
